title: Plan: immersive magic-themed sign-in page
description: Find a reputable agent skill/repo for high-end UI and motion, and plan a sign-in page redesign with a smooth magical/arcane animation theme that respects reduced motion and performance budgets.
design:
# Plan: immersive "kiln magic" sign-in page

## Skills and sources (owner asked to build on UI/UX Pro Max and the "awesome" component collections)
Layered so each source does what it is best at, and the brand (docs/BRAND.md, packages/ui tokens) stays the source of truth for colour, type and motion tokens:
1. **UI/UX Pro Max** (nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill, MIT, ~143k stars): install as a Claude Code plugin
   (`/plugin marketplace add nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill`, `/plugin install ui-ux-pro-max@ui-ux-pro-max-skill`)
   or `uipro init --ai claude` (project scope, commit like the other skills). Use its design-system generator for the
   auth page pattern and effects, its 119 UX guidelines/anti-patterns and its pre-delivery checklist. Do NOT adopt its
   palettes or font pairings: map its recommendations onto vCraft tokens.
2. **impeccable** (already in .claude/skills): `shape`/`craft` for the direction brief and comp, `overdrive` for the
   shader/particle moments, `animate` + `delight`, then `audit` + `optimize`.
3. **emilkowalski/skills** (`improve-animations`, `review-animations`, `animation-vocabulary`): motion polish,
   interruptible springs, timing review. `npx skills add emilkowalski/skills`.
4. **Component sources from the awesome lists**, copied in as source (shadcn-style), restyled to our tokens, never as
   a runtime dependency on a whole kit:
   - React Bits (DavidHDev/react-bits, ~35k stars; licence MIT + Commons Clause: fine to use inside the product, not to
     resell the components): `Aurora` / `Particles` / `Threads` backgrounds as the base of the night-kiln shader,
     `BlurText`/`SplitText` for the heading, `ClickSpark` for the submit button.
   - Magic UI (magicuidesign/magicui, MIT): `BorderBeam` / `ShineBorder` for the glazed card edge, `AnimatedBeam`
     if we show "QR → trace" on the side panel, `Meteors` as a reduced-cost ember fallback.
   - Aceternity UI (free tier only): `BackgroundBeams`/`Sparkles` as references; check each component's licence
     before copying.
   Each copied component: record source URL + licence in a header comment, strip unused props, swap colours for tokens,
   add a reduced-motion branch, keep it a lazy client island.
Not chosen: heygen-com/hyperframes (video composition, not web UI), generic framer-motion skills (overlap with 2 and 3).

## Direction (fits docs/BRAND.md §6: motion must have intent; "Lò đêm" signature moment)
"Phép thuật ảo ma" translated into vCraft's own world — the alchemy of the kiln and blue-and-white glaze, not generic fantasy:
- Night-kiln backdrop: full-bleed WebGL shader (R3F + three, already dependencies) of drifting embers and heat shimmer, slow, low-contrast so the form stays readable; pointer parallax on desktop, gyroscope-free on mobile.
- Hoa lam runes: cobalt brush-stroke motifs (lotus, waves, clouds from the brand pattern set) draw themselves around the form with SVG stroke animation (GSAP DrawSVG or motion pathLength), as if painted on an unfired vase.
- Form as a glazed tile: card with a subtle glaze sheen that follows the pointer (CSS conic/radial gradient, no JS on mobile).
- Focus/typing: each field's underline glows ember-orange on focus; password field shows a tiny kiln flame that grows with strength (no sound).
- Submit: button "fires" (ease.press), ember particles converge into the trace seal; success = seal stamps (signature moment #2) then View Transition into the destination; error = brief crackle on the card + shake ≤ 280 ms with the message announced to screen readers.
- Applies to sign-in, sign-up, forgot/reset password and invitation pages via one shared `<ArcaneAuthShell>` in the (auth) layout.

## Constraints
- prefers-reduced-motion: no shader, no particles, no draw-on; static night-kiln illustration + 150 ms fades (BRAND §6.4).
- Performance: the form must be interactive before any effect loads. Shader canvas is a client island loaded with `next/dynamic` + `ssr:false` after `requestIdleCallback`; pause when tab hidden; cap DPR at 1.5; ≤ 120 KB gzip extra JS (BRAND budget); Lighthouse mobile on /vi/dang-nhap ≥ 90 and no regression on other pages; 55+ fps on a mid-range phone; fall back to CSS if WebGL is unavailable.
- Accessibility: contrast ≥ 4.5:1 over the animated background (form sits on an opaque glazed card), visible focus, errors in aria-live, no motion tied to essential info, works with password managers and Supabase auth flows untouched.
- No change to auth logic; Turnstile placement preserved.

## Slices
0. Install UI/UX Pro Max + emilkowalski/skills (one small PR); run the Pro Max generator for "craft village heritage marketplace, sign-in" and record the mapped decisions in the bead.
1. `impeccable shape` → direction brief + static comp of the auth shell (vi/en, 360/1280, light/dark) for owner approval.
2. Static shell + glazed card + reduced-motion art (server component) on all auth pages.
3. Hoa lam draw-on + field/button micro-interactions (motion, gsap).
4. Ember/heat shader island (R3F) with idle loading, visibility pause, WebGL fallback.
5. Success seal stamp + View Transition; error crackle.
6. Pro Max pre-delivery checklist + `review-animations` + `impeccable audit/optimize`; Lighthouse and Playwright checks through :8080; e2e auth specs still green.
notes:
Slice 0 (2026-11-02): installed project-scoped via skills CLI (skills-lock.json): ui-ux-pro-max (nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill, MIT) and emilkowalski/skills improve-animations, review-animations, animation-vocabulary, animation-performance (skipped emil's animate/prototype to avoid name clashes with impeccable and mattpocock prototype). Pro Max scripts are stdlib-only, local CSV, no network.

Pro Max design-system run ("craft village heritage marketplace sign-in immersive") mapped onto vCraft:
- Pattern "Hero + Testimonials + CTA": rejected (auth is an Operate surface; PRODUCT.md forbids invented testimonials).
- Style "Vibrant & Block-based", palette #7C3AED/#16A34A, fonts Amatic SC/Cabin: rejected; tokens stay BRAND.md (paper/ink/clay/glaze/seal, Fraunces/Be Vietnam Pro/JetBrains Mono).
- Kept as acceptance rules: WCAG 2.2 accessible authentication (paste + password managers, autocomplete=current-password, show/hide toggle), errors via role=alert/aria-live near the field, loading -> success/error submit feedback, 44px targets, visible focus, no horizontal scroll at 375/768/1024/1440, reduced-motion honoured, hover 150-300ms.
- Kept from threejs stack: particle count baseline <=3000 (we target far fewer), no shadows, low segment counts.
- Pre-delivery checklist (references/pro-rules.md) runs at slice 6.
Work branch: feat/83g41-kiln-auth (worktree .claude/worktrees/kiln-auth).
